fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.33.3 fixes PPA target synchronization by normalizing PPA's non-explicit target-actor sentinel for transport and reproducing PPA's native active-runtime refresh after remote setTarget/setInteraction writes. OCum 3D overlays continue to use the RaceMenu ActorUpdateManager repair validated in v0.33.2.
